verdict.rationale: EBANX documents its own recurring-payment capability: recurring Pix with automatic debit authorization, which it pitches as simplifying subscription management, and a Recurring Payments solution with tokenized cards and smart retry logic. That covers recurring charging only; nothing shows a subscription-billing engine with plan objects, trial periods, plan upgrades or proration. Missing for 10: plan definitions, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade handling, proration logic, developer API docs for subscription lifecycle, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Enable recurring Pix payments with automatic debit authorization, reducing churn and simplifying subscription management.
Recurring Payments solution that includes local currency and alternative payment method acceptance, unified reconciliation, smart retry logic, tokenized credit card payments
